description: Test file for the audit context functionalities in Kubernetes API server, including tests for enabling audit, adding annotations, and retrieving user info.

methods.name: TestEnabled
methods.description: Tests the enabling logic of AuditContext based on different levels.

methods.name: TestAddAuditAnnotation
methods.description: Tests adding annotations to the audit context under various levels and concurrent scenarios.

methods.name: TestAuditAnnotationsWithAuditLoggingSetup
methods.description: Verifies annotations are correctly accumulated before and after audit policy evaluation.

methods.name: TestGetEventUser
methods.description: Checks retrieval and immutability of UserInfo from audit events.

methods.name: TestGetEventImpersonatedUser
methods.description: Checks retrieval and immutability of ImpersonatedUserInfo from audit events.

methods.name: withAuditContextAndLevel
methods.description: Helper function to initialize audit context with a specific level for testing.
